entries.title: 忍者くん 阿修羅ノ章／たまゲー
entries.notes: Second-pass genuine game footage at 7290s and 9580s shows green-tiled Famicom Ninja-kun vertical stages with HUD score, remaining lives and item, while studio overlay at 8380s explicitly reads 『忍者くん 阿修羅ノ章』. Interleaved with One Piece arcade-location footage; no exact programme cut.

entries.title: クイズ殿様の野望2 全国版／たまゲー
entries.notes: At 136670s the programme's upper-left challenge banner explicitly reads 『クイズ殿様の野望2 全国版』に挑戦. Actual in-game quiz questions at 137170s (Sailor Mercury) and on-site arcade visits at 136080s. The title is video-visible, boundaries remain provisional.

entries.title: レトロゲームクイズ ファミオネア／アクションゲーム映像
entries.notes: Video at 143630s has explicit programme segment heading 『レトロゲーム愛を確かめる クイズ ファミオネア』 and on-screen four-answer Rockman charger quiz. At 143040s also 8-bit action gameplay, and 145330s another 3D adventure game. This is a verified programme corner, not a single game episode.

entries.title: デッドフォックス／番組内クイズ
entries.notes: At 157550s explicit programme upper-left card says 『デッドフォックス』に挑戦; at 156960s actual side-view forest Capcom 1989/1990 Dead Fox gameplay (TIME, PTS, lives HUD). At 158050s other Mario quiz. Provisional nav spans both.

entries.title: クレイジー・クライマー／AD天内企画
entries.notes: At 171470s upper-left screen caption reads 『クレイジー・クライマー』に挑戦; at 171970s purple Famicom vertical climbing game with 2D girder grid; +950s a separate AD天内 studio visit, and +360s preceding credits. Correct game name is visible but no verified episode start/end.

entries.title: 超兄貴（PCE）／たまゲー
entries.notes: At 94710s the PCE shooter features a player craft, ornate HUD HI SCORE/LEFT/BOMB/SPEED and fantastical castle; at 95210s the GCCX upper-left programme banner explicitly reads 『超兄貴』に挑戦. The 96060s shooter boss is a giant muscleman, confirming the game. This time-navigation clip also includes unrelated Game Boy and arcade visit segments. Boundary not verified.

entries.title: 地底戦空バゾルダー／たまゲー
entries.notes: At 109980s the screen explicitly reads 『地底戦空バゾルダー』に挑戦. Actual gameplay at 108630s/110855s shows NES SOFEL cave stages, with HUD FUEL/SHIELD and CHARGE/DRILL, VZR T-FORM. Programme guide #224 matches; interleaved arcade visit; the clip start/end are not episode cuts.

entries.title: メソポタミア／クイズ ファミオネア
entries.notes: At 133490s the screen explicitly reads 『メソポタミア』に挑戦; at 132990/133430s is PC Engine moving-centipede boss gameplay. At 135215s a different in-show retro game quiz quiz-panel is visible. The official guide identifies #227, but the navigational cut is provisional.

entries.title: 魔法アクションゲーム／メガリット（GB）紹介
entries.notes: At 164310s and 164510s actual fantasy magic-action side-scrolling combat with HUD MAGIC and boss, +950s arcade visit. At 166535s an actual Super Game Boy title screen clearly reads 'MEGALIT ©1991 ASMIK', whose official Japanese title is メガリット. No assertion that Megalit is the principal challenge of this window, nor exact boundary.

entries.title: ゲームボーイRPG王宮場面／クォース
entries.notes: SGB-style Game Boy story and castle sequence at +35/+155; at +600 vertical shooting/puzzle footage of Konami Quarth; at +1800 challenge header clearly says 『クォース』に挑戦. This navigation clip mixes games.

entries.title: クォース挑戦結果／ジョイメカファイト
entries.notes: At +35 title card explicitly says 『クォース』挑戦失敗; from +600 to +1800 Nintendo Joy Mech Fight (スカポン and ホノオ etc) gameplay. Mixed clip.

entries.title: ジョイメカファイト／GCCX mini生放送
entries.notes: At +35 upper-left 『ジョイメカファイト』に挑戦, +155 game-closing castle screen, +600/+1800 GCCXmini LIVE with colourful timed puzzle game. Not a single confirmed programme.

entries.title: ゼビウス観察日記／GCCX mini生放送
entries.notes: At +35 『ゼビウス観察日記』 archival title, at +155 dated season collection and +600/+1800 GCCXmini live talk. Programme collage and live special, no exact boundaries.

entries.title: GCCX mini 生放送／カイの冒険 企画
entries.notes: At +35 GCCXmini LIVE on-screen block puzzle challenge; +155 printed audience suggestion 『2007年12月 カイの冒険』; +600 studio guests and +1800 control room. The sheet is a live-broadcast composite.

entries.title: 悪魔城ドラキュラX系アクション（挑戦映像）
entries.notes: At +35/+155/+600/+1800 actual Konami 16-bit Richter-like blue-costumed vampire castle action, 01/score HUD and skeleton bosses. Belongs to Castlevania X series; specific release is not proven by a full title card.

entries.title: 悪魔城ドラキュラX系アクション（続き）
entries.notes: At +35/+155/+600/+1800 same Konami gothic blue-clothed hero, crosses moonlit bridge and fights vampire boss. Same series as preceding nav, unverified episode cut.

entries.title: ザ・ハウス・オブ・ザ・デッド（ガンシューティング）
entries.notes: At +35/+155/+600 3D first-person rail shooter with zombies, winged gargoyle and health/fire cursor; +1800 HOLD YOUR FIRE boss end screen. The House of the Dead game appears; exact entry/end unverified.

entries.title: ドラゴンファイター挑戦／占いゲームの館
entries.notes: At +35 end/title montage, +155 『占いゲームの館』 segment, +600 programme header explicitly 『ドラゴンファイター』に挑戦, and +1800 Famicom style game end credits. Mixed-content period.

entries.title: ゲームセンターCX オフィシャルファンクラブ告知
entries.notes: All four decoded frames are an identical 『ゲームセンターCX オフィシャルファンクラブ 8/3(月)始動!!』 card, not game footage. Label only the actual video content; date on card is an archived promo, not a current announcement.
